products.label: Curried and ready-to-eat vegetables
products.identity: Heat-processed culinary preparation of vegetables, legumes, cereals or pulses. The recipe may include oils, spices or milk fat.
products.sourceReviewResult: Sections 2.3.4(1)–(3) cover the heat-processed preparation, additives, Appendix B and rigid-container fill. The product standard gives a 90% minimum by occupied volume for a rigid container. Its text specifies no drained-weight or soluble-solids minimum.
products.sourceReviewNextAction: Identify the prepared food and pack. For a rigid container, record the occupied volume and full distilled-water capacity at 20 °C. Match Appendix B and any additives to the recipe and process.

products.label: Thermally processed vegetable soups
products.identity: Heat-processed vegetable soup supplied for direct consumption, prepared from vegetable juice, pulp or purée. It may be clear or cloudy.

solids.basis: Finished soup, total soluble solids as % by mass (m/m)

types.label: Direct-consumption vegetable soup, other than tomato soup

products.sourceReviewResult: Section 2.3.5(2) gives a minimum of 5.0% total soluble solids by mass for vegetable soup and 7.0% for tomato soup. Section 2.3.5(4) gives 90% minimum occupied volume for a rigid container measured by full distilled-water capacity at 20 °C.
products.sourceReviewNextAction: Identify the soup as supplied and its tomato or other vegetable identity. Record the reporting basis of the finished-soup result, the container type and any rigid-pack measurements.
